capabilities: Save cursor and scroll position separately for each note
Restore positions for all open tabs on app restart
Save positions in both editing and reading mode
Merge position data when a sync tool replaces the data file
Configure save interval, restore delay and maximum stored entries
extras: Positions are stored in a JSON file inside the plugin folder, which Obsidian Sync does not sync; whole-vault sync tools such as iCloud, Syncthing and Dropbox merge positions across devices. Beta versions can be installed through BRAT.
problem: Obsidian does not keep your place in each note, and on mobile the app can be killed by the system, so your reading spot is lost.
summary: Plugin that saves cursor and scroll position for each note and restores every open tab's position when Obsidian restarts.
